sprint: The Grid — Auditing Every Object Kind Against Builder's Honor Commitments
task: A direct, requested audit: 'ok now lets work out the grid for each object for what can be done against the builder honor commitments' -- Governing Rule #2, Guardrails: 'Every object on Scene honors the guardrails.' Read every relevant function end to end (_resolvePlacePermissions, _supportsResize, _layerVisual, _pushLayerObject, _appendWorldObjectEditControl, the reorder-bucket functions) to build a real grid -- 7 World-owned object kinds x 6 capabilities (Visible/Move/Resize/Reorder/Edit Content/Decoration Slot) -- rather than guessing which cells were real. Confirmed the declarative type:'sticker' Layer Pack kind (a Wax-Seal-style theme glyph, genuinely separate from type:'decoration'/type:'text') never got the same treatment the rest of the grid did, surfacing two real, confirmed gaps: (1) Resize was structurally offered (handles show) but silently inert -- _layerDrawSticker never read a Story-Author size override at all; (2) a glyph-less colour-fallback sticker's edit control was a dead end in two places -- _layerVisual never read the fillColor override back (so the popup/thumbnail always showed the stale original colour) and _layerDrawSticker's own paint never read it either (so an edit never actually changed what rendered). Both fixed to match the identical ov.fillColor/ov.size precedence already established for decoration/text kinds. Every other cell in the grid was confirmed already correct -- Places deliberately get no resize (no size-override mechanism exists, a disclosed scope decision not a bug), Frame Look/Style gates on editable while Add/Replace Artwork stays always-available (Story's own content), Reorder is uniformly available across every kind gated purely on moveable, a real glyph-bearing sticker correctly shows no edit control at all (N/A by design), and there is deliberately no Story-Author-facing Show/Hide toggle anywhere. Verified via a new synthetic-theme Playwright test driving real SceneEngine.setSize/.setContentOverride calls and sampling canvas pixels with a tolerance band -- 6/6 assertions confirm both fixes. Full regression across text_resize_grid_test.js, commitments_test.js, bug332_334_335_verify.js, and museum_realfile_regression.js passes unchanged. Confined to two functions, _layerVisual and _layerDrawSticker, in renderer/slideRenderer.js.
